summary: BIONIC™ micro-delimited zones testing completed successfully. All features working as expected: BIONIC analysis runs, Score Global displays (68/100), real-time data shows (weather, terrain, vegetation), and 1390 hexagonal micro-zones are rendered on the map with transparency. Tooltips display module name, percentage, and rating on hover.

issues: BIONIC™ Zones section requires scrolling to bottom of Layers panel to view - consider making it more prominent or auto-scrolling when zones are generated

critical_code_review_comments: BIONIC zones implementation is working correctly with 1390 micro-zones generated
Zones are properly transparent (fillOpacity: 0.02-0.08) allowing terrain visibility
Tooltips display correctly with module icon, percentage, and rating
BIONIC™ Zones section in Layers panel shows all module statistics
Score Global (68/100) matches expected value for Quebec location
context_for_next_testing_agent: BIONIC™ micro-delimited zones feature fully tested and working. To view zones: 1) Go to /territory, 2) Click 'BIONIC™ Territory Engine' button in sidebar, 3) Click 'Lancer l'analyse', 4) Wait ~20 seconds for analysis, 5) Close modal, 6) Click Layers button (right side), 7) Scroll to bottom to see 'BIONIC™ Zones' section with module controls.

bionic_button_click.notes: Button visible in sidebar, opens BIONIC modal on click

real_time_data_section.notes: Données en temps réel section shows: Météo (-19.8°C), Terrain (55m), Végétation (NDVI: 0.15)

bionic_zones_on_map.notes: 1390 hexagonal micro-zones rendered on map with transparency

zones_transparency.notes: Zones are transparent (fillOpacity: 0.02-0.08), terrain visible underneath

tooltip_on_hover.notes: Tooltip displays module icon, percentage (e.g., 66%), module name (Zone Pression), and rating (Bonne probabilité)

bionic_zones_sidebar_section.notes: BIONIC™ Zones section appears in Layers panel with: 1390 micro-zones, Score Global 68/100, 6/8 modules active
